name: Beginner
summary: Introduce yourself and handle everyday phrases.
description: Start from zero. This course teaches you the sounds, the articles and the everyday sentences you need to introduce yourself, ask simple questions and get by in simple situations.
highlights: Introduce yourself and others, and say where you live and what you do
Ask and answer simple questions about daily life
Understand and use greetings, numbers, dates and times

name: Elementary
summary: Describe your routine, the past and simple plans.
description: Build on your first steps. You learn to describe what you did, what you can and must do, and to handle shopping, travel and the doctor in clear, simple German.
highlights: Talk about work, family, shopping and free time in simple sentences
Describe past events using the Perfekt
Understand short, clear messages and announcements

name: Intermediate
summary: Give opinions, write emails, manage most situations.
description: B1 is where German starts to feel like your own language. You give opinions, explain reasons, write emails and follow the main points of everyday conversation and news.
highlights: Deal with most situations while travelling, studying or working in German
Describe experiences, plans and opinions, and give reasons
Understand the main points of clear standard speech

name: Upper intermediate
summary: Join discussions and write formal, detailed texts.
description: At B2 you follow lectures and professional texts and take part in discussions with native speakers. The course sharpens your grammar, widens your vocabulary and trains formal writing.
highlights: Interact fluently and spontaneously with native speakers
Understand complex texts on concrete and abstract topics
Write clear, detailed texts and formal letters

name: Advanced
summary: Fluent, flexible German for study and career.
description: C1 learners express themselves fluently without searching for words. The course focuses on style, register, long texts and well-structured argument for study and professional life.
highlights: Understand demanding, longer texts and implicit meaning
Use the language flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes
shows: Effective, flexible use for study and work

name: Proficient
summary: Nuance, precision and the highest Goethe certificate.
description: The highest level. C2 training refines nuance, tone and precision, and prepares you for the Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom, the top certificate of the Goethe-Institut.
highlights: Understand virtually everything you read or hear with ease
Summarise information from different sources into a coherent account
Express yourself spontaneously with fine shades of meaning
